verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping service. A buyer could fairly ask whether such a SaaS can be driven programmatically, so the axis applies. Its 'automation' claims cover bank-feed data entry and categorization inside the web app, which is adjacent, not headless or CI execution. Probes found no API surface: the llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI paths all returned 404, and nothing documents a CLI, API or headless mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
